correctness.rationale: The source defines a finite regular CW complex of nonempty triples \(A,B,C\) with cyclic all-to-all arcs \(A\to B\to C\to A\). Independent exhaustive constructions give \((165,495,330)\) cells and no higher cells. Exact product orientations give \(\partial_1\partial_2=0\). The one-skeleton is connected, hence \(\operatorname{rank}\partial_1=164\). In the \(495\)-by-\(330\) matrix of \(\partial_2\), the \(330\) double-incidence rows form five \(66\)-vertex components. Their \(325\) spanning-tree rows are integral unit pivots and the five unused double rows are redundant. The \(165\) triple-incidence rows reduce to the five signed relation patterns displayed in RESULT.md. The resulting five-by-five matrix has determinant \(33\) and a unit four-by-four minor, so \(\partial_2\) has Smith invariants \(1\) repeated \(329\) times and one \(33\). It has rational rank \(330\), yielding \(H_1\cong\mathbb Z\oplus\mathbb Z/33\mathbb Z\) and \(H_2=0\). The modular ranks at primes \(2,3,5,11,13\) are \((330,329,330,329,330)\), confirming the primes in the invariant. The affine and converse-reflection cellular maps, with signed Lefschetz traces, check the free-line symmetry. All calculations replay from the bundled `verify.py` after extraction. This does not determine the fundamental group or homotopy type.

originality.rationale: Actual published-finding corpus searches for Paley-11 directed triangle Hom, alternative quadratic-residue/doubly regular tournament descriptions, cellular homology and 33 torsion did not yield an equivalent statement. The foundational 2021 full-text source defines directed Hom and covers transitive tournaments and selected small examples, not the Paley-eleven torsion computation. The closest published same-functor result computes Hom(C3,R9) ~= S1 for a different target, with no torsion; target substitution and graph reductions do not make its theorem cover Paley-eleven. Other indexed Paley results concern directed flag, out-neighborhood or path homology, not this Hom functor. Negative search is not a global uniqueness proof.

value.rationale: This is the first canonical prime-order Paley target beyond seven where the directed triangle Hom object is genuinely two-dimensional. Its one-skeleton has 495 edges and every edge belongs to multiple 2-cells, so the exact 3- and 11-primary first-homology torsion is not an Euler-characteristic or collapse-by-free-faces deduction. The five 66-face incidence components and five-by-five presentation explain the unusual composite invariant 33 structurally and furnish a reusable integral test case for topology of regular tournament multihomomorphism spaces. It is a precise, motivated exact natural invariant rather than an arbitrary slice or a minor parameter improvement. No unsupported downstream theorem or family classification is needed for its value.
